'''Cooling Grids''' were [[Cooling unit/Legends|cooling units]] installed on [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] such as [[Borstel Galactic Defense/Legends|Borstel's]] [[NK-7 ion cannon/Legends|NK-7 unit]]. The grid was positioned at the top of the turret near the [[Energy Coupler]].<ref name="EGWT" />
